name: Angelus ~Haitoku no Jokyoku~
source:
Main character's fiancée dies, and it's presented as a suicide. Main character moves to the pavilion where his fiancée worked and died. He decides to stay at this mysterious place for a while.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的未婚妻死去，而她的死被宣称是自杀。主人公搬进了未婚妻生前工作、并最终死去的那座别馆，决定暂时留在这个神秘的地方。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
